strings: Huffing and puffing, m_c goes to r_c0 to ask if {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/have/has} anything that can help in the dirtmaking department.
m_c feels incredibly miserable, bloated, and stuffed full without being able to get rid of the feeling.
Pitifully, m_c has spent most of the day in the dirtplace uselessly trying to make dirt.
